'''catman421 Ralltiir Operations (ROPS) (V2)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 6 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 ROps catman421 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Second Ralops deck.  Suggestions needed.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

---Responses---

Shewski-

If I am going to remove Biker Scout Gear, the comlinks would go with it for sure.  The AO is We’re In Attack Position Now.  Trample was suppose to be in the deck, it just never got written down,  Mosep may be a good idea, Im not really sure.  Im considering the removal of Blizzard 1 and Veers for more room.  I use the fourth site only if more drains are needed.  Thinner is good, since you can activate more (possibly) early and is a used 6.  Thanks for the review.

---Strategy---

Control Ralltiir with massive amounts of power.  Keep the Rebels off Ralltiir and drain my opponent into nothingness.

-Early Game-

Avoid playing anything (except sites to Ralltiir) until you can deploy enough to flip and consolidate.  Flip obj as soon as possible.

-Mid Game-

If everything goes right, there isnt a mid-game.  If needed, go fight your opponent.  Otherwise, sit at Ralltiir and drain.

-End Game-

If light does go to Ralltiir, it likely will be a desparate move.  Be alert for EPP beatdowns.  Even still, you should be fine.  If extra damage is needed, play the fourth site to Ralltiir, if not, use it a forfeit fodder.  Drains should run about 8 per turn, so light will not have very long to live.

Blaster Rack (V)-

Pulls weapons.

Imperial Arrest Order-

Adds to forfiet of many characters and prevents Naburn beatdowns.

Biker Scout Gear-

Makes bikers harder to kill.  Boosts Colink's destiny.

General Tagge (V)-

Pulls any trooper from reserve deck, including bikers.

Dath Maul, YA-

Powerful character,especailly with his saber.  Very dangerous towards opponent's jedi.

Lord Vader-

More overall power than your basic Vader, especially when armed with a saber.

P-59 and P-60-

Extra power and fire support.  Add a destiny too.

Guri and Prince Xizor-

Lots of power and limit opponent's battle destinies.

Dr. E and Ponda Baba-

More power and can eliminate hit characters.

Kitik Keed'kak (V)-

Lots of power (second most powerful character in the game).  Adds to attrition.

Bikers Scouts-

Add different abilities and lots of power on bikes.

Mara Jade, TEH-

A third dark jedi (well, almost) for dark.

General Veers (V)-

A beast while on Blizzard 1.

Emperor Palpatine-

High destiny and ability.  Boosts Mara's overall effectiveness.

Thrawn and Pellaeon-

Pilot either Executor or Chimaera.

Blizzard 1 (V)-

A crap load of power.  Adds to attrition.

Blizzard 2 (V)-

More power, pulls Trample and Walker Barrage.

Blizzard 4-

Pulls Imperials.

Speeder Bikes-

React, and a 'base' for the bikers.

Zuckuss In Mist Hunter-

Limits battle destinies.

Boba Fett In Slave 1-

Lots of power and a destiny.

Executor-

For beatdowns.  Will kill any moderate force.

Chimaera-

A mini Executor.

Imperial Reinforcements (V)-

Bring back many Imperial characters and starships.

We’re All Going To Be A Lot Thinner (V)-

Destiny 6, cancels crap and offers the possibility for improve activation, especially against a force choke deck.

Walker Barrage-

Character removal.

Twi’lek Advisor-

High destiny and effect pull.

We Must Accelerate Our Plans-

Pulls effects and Blockade Flagship: Bridge.

High-Speed Tactics-

Tallon Roll for bikes, also destiny 5.

Send A Detachment Down (V)-

Steals, boosts a trooper’s power and gives retrieval all in one package.

Security Precautions (V)-

Increaced Activation, forfeit bonuses, cancels Revolution and prevents deploy modifiers.

Presence Of The Force-

Add to drains.

Search And Destroy-

Adds to biker’s forfeit and damages opponent.

All Sabers-

Provide good weapons shots and drain bonuses.

Comlink-

Destiny 5 (with Biker Scout Gear).  Allows for reacts.

Tanks in advance for reviews.
